title: Carnatic Music & The Melakarta System
subtitle: The Combinatorial Lattice of Raga: A Discrete Mathematical Architecture

blocks.explanation: Carnatic music, through the Melakarta system, is a complete, discrete, systematic enumeration of all heptatonic scales derivable from the twelve semitones of the octave. Twelve semitones form the discrete pitch space; seventy-two parent scales (six chakras by twelve melas) exhaust the combinations under fixed Sa and Pa; all other ragas are Janya ragas derived by omission, zig-zag movement, and ornamentation. The seventy-two Melakartas form a combinatorial lattice with rich symmetries — a discrete counterpart to the continuous Hindustani manifold, and a triumph of mathematical completeness from which infinite beauty emerges.
